COMBINE_STATE_COPY.combine_verified: Measured from a standardized ScoutBox Combine Protocol during a live Box Cam session, with a supported detector, and passed the required integrity checks.
COMBINE_STATE_COPY.partially_measured: The standardized measurement window was not fully observed, so this attempt is recorded as a measurement but is not Combine Verified. No value is projected or estimated.
COMBINE_STATE_COPY.measurement_unavailable: This Combine measurement is not yet supported on this device. ScoutBox does not estimate or fabricate a result.
COMBINE_STATE_COPY.protocol_invalid: The attempt did not follow the standardized protocol, so no verified measurement was produced.
COMBINE_STATE_COPY.integrity_review: This result is under integrity review and does not currently count as Combine Verified.
COMBINE_STATE_COPY.invalidated: This Combine result was invalidated after review and no longer counts as Combine Verified.
COMBINE_STATE_COPY.cancelled: This Combine Attempt was cancelled before completion.

COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.title: Box Touch 60
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.description: As many controlled alternating touches on top of the ball as possible in 60 seconds.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.setupRequirements: Full body and ball in frame, stable phone, 2m × 2m clear area.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.cameraRequirements: Portrait, ~2.5m distance, whole body and ball visible throughout.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.startRule: The 60-second measurement window begins when the attempt starts.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.finishRule: The window closes at 60 seconds. Only touches observed inside the window count.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.validAttemptRules: Player and ball must remain observable. If observation is lost, the attempt is partially measured, never estimated.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.scoringMethod: Verified, de-duplicated touch count inside the 60-second window.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.safetyNotes: Warm up first. Stop on any pain — recorded work still counts.

COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.title: Box Juggle
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.description: Total verified juggles (keepy-uppies) within a 60-second window.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.setupRequirements: Full body in frame, ball never leaves the frame vertically.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.cameraRequirements: Portrait, ~3m distance, high ceiling or outdoors preferred.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.startRule: The 60-second window begins when the attempt starts.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.finishRule: Total verified juggles inside the window. Maximum-consecutive is not measured (no reliable detector).
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.validAttemptRules: Player and ball must remain observable throughout.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.scoringMethod: Verified, de-duplicated juggle count inside the window.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.safetyNotes: Warm up first. Stop on any pain — recorded work still counts.

COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.title: Box Control 60
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.description: Verified active close-control time inside a fixed 60-second protocol.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.startRule: The 60-second window begins when the attempt starts.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.finishRule: Verified active control time observed inside the window (max 60.0s).
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.validAttemptRules: If the ball or player leaves frame, that time does not count; a short-observed window is partially measured.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.scoringMethod: Verified active-control seconds ∩ ball-visible, inside the window.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.safetyNotes: Warm up first. Stop on any pain — recorded work still counts.

COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.title: Box Footwork
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.setupRequirements: Feet clearly visible between two markers.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.startRule: Intervals begin when the attempt starts.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.finishRule: Number of completed intervals out of the target.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.validAttemptRules: Player must remain observable during work intervals; rest intervals never count against the result.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.safetyNotes: Rest 30–60s between sets. Stop on any pain.

COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.title: Box Strength 60
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.description: Valid observed bodyweight squat repetitions in 60 seconds. General physical-development evidence — not a measure of football ability.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.startRule: The 60-second window begins when the attempt starts.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.finishRule: Valid observed repetitions inside the window.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.validAttemptRules: Controlled tempo; partial-range reps are not counted.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.scoringMethod: Verified, de-duplicated squat count inside the window.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.safetyNotes: Bodyweight only. Stop on any pain. Not medical advice.

COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.title: 5-10-5 Agility
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.description: Standardized 5-10-5 pro-agility shuttle. Requires spatial calibration and automated timing gates.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.setupRequirements: Three markers exactly 5 metres apart (Box Marker).
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.scoringMethod: Automated start/finish timing — not available in this environment.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.safetyNotes: Requires a large, flat, clear surface.

COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.title: 10 m Acceleration
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.description: Standardized 10-metre acceleration. Requires spatial calibration and automated timing gates.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.setupRequirements: Two markers exactly 10 metres apart (Box Marker).
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.scoringMethod: Automated start/finish timing — not available in this environment.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.safetyNotes: Requires a straight, flat, clear 15m+ run.

COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.title: Standing Broad Jump
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.description: Standardized standing broad jump. Requires physical-scale calibration.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.setupRequirements: Calibration marker of known size in frame (Box Marker).
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.scoringMethod: Calibrated distance measurement — not available in this environment.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.safetyNotes: Land safely on a soft, clear surface.

COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.title: Passing Target
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.description: Successful passes into a defined target zone out of attempts. Requires target-zone detection.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.setupRequirements: Defined target zone visible in frame.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.scoringMethod: Objective successful/attempted ratio — not available in this environment.
COMBINE_PROTOCOLS.safetyNotes: Clear the area around the target.
